title: Striking the Closing Premium Balance When a Ridgecrest Advantage Enrollment Is Brought to an End
content:
The closing premium balance is what a member is left owing for plan premium when their Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment is brought to an end at their own election.

**The closing premium balance** is the plan premium reckoned against the settlement, together with the plan premium for the coverage months the settlement still charges for, less the payments allowed against the settlement, less the relief allowed against the settlement, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end, and it is never less than nothing.

**The plan premium reckoned against the settlement** is the most recent plan premium charge standing on the premium account.

**The coverage months the settlement still charges for** are none, that is 0 coverage months.

**The plan premium for the coverage months the settlement still charges for** is those coverage months multiplied by the plan premium of a coverage month the settlement charges for.

**The plan premium of a coverage month the settlement charges for** is the monthly plan premium of the plan held taken at the share of it charged to the member, rounded to the nearest cent.

**The share of the monthly plan premium charged to the member** is the whole of it, that is 100 per cent of it.

**The coverage months the plan premium charges standing on the account cover** are counted as three for every such charge where the enrollment is billed quarterly, and as one for every such charge where the enrollment is billed monthly.

**The coverage months the enrollment has been in force** are the whole months that have passed since the coverage effective date, and one more for the month in hand.

**The payments allowed against the settlement** are the most recent plan premium payment standing on the premium account.

**The relief allowed against the settlement** is nothing.

Only the member, or a representative they have appointed in writing, may bring the enrollment to an end, the coverage runs to the last day of the month in which the plan received their request, and a member who leaves outside an election period returns to Original Medicare.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a premium account whose most recent plan premium charge is 150.00 USD and whose most recent plan premium payment is 120.00 USD, and a monthly plan premium for the plan held of 45.00 USD.

- Plan premium reckoned against the settlement: 150.00 USD.
- Coverage months the settlement still charges for: 0, so the plan premium for them is 0 multiplied by the plan premium of such a coverage month, which is nothing.
- Plan premium of a coverage month the settlement charges for: 45.00 USD taken at the whole of it, so 45.00 USD; nothing is charged for it here because there are no such coverage months.
- Payments allowed against the settlement: 120.00 USD.
- Relief allowed against the settlement: nothing.
- Closing premium balance: 150.00 USD together with nothing, less 120.00 USD, less nothing, rounded once at the end, so **30.00 USD**.
